messages:
elena (People Ops): Quick post-all-hands thread for leftover Qs on leveling, promos, and benefits (esp. open enrollment timing). Keep replies short and we'll follow up. Calibration window: 2025-02-10 to 2025-02-14. Manager confirmations due 2025-02-10. Retro/adjustment payroll target: 2025-03-01.

max (IC): If my manager recommends no level change but I have supporting impact examples, what's the best way to surface them? Can I add them directly?

elena (People Ops): Best route: DM your manager your bullets + links, ask them to paste into the peer-evidence doc or attach to the packet. If manager declines, email people-ops with your examples and we'll advise next steps; HR can request a calibration follow-up if there is strong new evidence.

rafa (Eng Manager): Managers: please attach 2 concise impact bullets + 1 artifact (PR link, metric, or customer quote) for any upward rec. Use bullets like: "drove X -> Y" or "reduced latency 30% -> +$Z ARR".

max (IC): Open enrollment Q: will benefits changes (e.g., new dental plan) affect total comp discussions or caps in offers?

elena (People Ops): Benefits changes don't alter base salary bands. They may shift overall total-rewards messaging but offers/commits remain based on bands and market data. We'll post a benefits summary after open enrollment closes.

payroll-bot: Resource pinned -> /handbook/reviews/calibration-rubric and /handbook/benefits/open-enrollment-summary.

sam (CEO): Quick note: leadership supports transparent calibration; if you see systemic issues, escalate to people-ops and your manager. And managers  please block time for calibration reviews.

elena (People Ops): We'll publish a 1-pager FAQ (timelines, appeals, comp-hot path) in #announcements by EOD Wednesday. If you have edge cases, DM me. :heart:
